item_name: Rothco Vintage USAF Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Vintage USAF Low Profile Cap is made from durable, 100% washed brushed cotton twill and features an embroidered Air Force logo on the brim alongside "USAF" on the front panel. Officially licensed by the United States Air Force, this adjustable cap with hook & loop closure combines timeless style with a commitment to military heritage.
